name: swarm-detector
description: Swarm Detector - Behavioral analysis workbench for Telegram coordination evidence
notes: Swarm Detector provides specialist behavioral analysis for Telegram coordination. Features include: network graph visualization, episode detection, stress testing, queue management, case review, and evidence comparison. Supports basic authentication for private deployments.

SWARM_DATA_DIR.description: Path to the Swarm Detector data directory

SWARM_BASIC_AUTH_USER.description: Username for basic authentication (leave empty to disable)

SWARM_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password for basic authentication (leave empty to disable)
